```artifact
Feature: Admin and Patient Interaction with Labs/Pharmacy Details, Registration, Profile Update, Appointments, Consultations, Prescriptions, and Consultations

  Background: All necessary prerequisites for the system functionalities are met

  #1 Admin shall be able to edit labs/pharmacy details (update/delete)
    Scenario: Admin edits existing lab details successfully
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin navigates to the labs/pharmacy details page
    And the admin selects an existing lab to edit
    And the admin enters valid update details
    Then the system should reflect the updated lab details
    Examples:
      | update details                                   | expected outcome                                  |
      | Correct lab name, updated address, new opening hours | Lab details updated successfully                   |
      | Incorrect lab name                             | Error message for invalid lab name                  |
      | Blank input fields                            | Error message for empty input fields               |

  #2 Patient shall be able to register
    Scenario: Patient registers successfully
    Given an empty registration form
    When the patient fills out and submits the form
    Then the system should register the patient
    Examples:
      | form data                                          | expected outcome                                  |
      | Valid name, date of birth, contact info               | Registration confirmation                       |
      | Invalid email                                     | Error message for invalid email                  |

  #3 Patient shall be able to update profile
    Scenario: Patient updates profile successfully
    Given the patient is logged in with a current profile
    When the patient selects 'Update Profile'
    And the patient enters new profile details
    Then the system should update the profile
    Examples:
      | new details                                             | expected outcome                                  |
      | New address, updated preferences                       | Profile updated successfully                   |
      | Blank input fields                                 | Error message for empty input fields               |

  #4 Patient shall be able to make appointments and submit online consultation requests
    Scenario: Patient makes an appointment and submits a request
    Given the patient has registered and is logged in
    When the patient selects 'Make Appointment'
    And the patient chooses a date and time
    And the patient submits the request
    Then the system should confirm the appointment
    Examples:
      | date and time                                        | appointment confirmation                       |
      | Invalid date/time                                 | Error message for invalid date/time              |

  #5 Patient shall be able to view and generate prescription reports and invoices
    Scenario: Patient views and generates reports successfully
    Given the patient has a prescription
    When the patient requests a report
    Then the system should generate and display the report
    Examples:
      | report type                                         | expected outcome                                  |
      | Detailed prescription report                        | Detailed report generated and displayed           |
      | Summary invoice                                   | Summary invoice generated and displayed           |

  #6 Doctor shall be able to provide consultation
    Scenario: Doctor provides consultation successfully
    Given the doctor is logged in
    When the doctor initiates a consultation
    Then the system should schedule the consultation
    Examples:
      | consultation date and time                         | consultation scheduled successfully              |

  #7 Doctor shall be able to prescribe medicine
    Scenario: Doctor prescribes medicine successfully
    Given the doctor has prescribed medicine
    When the doctor submits the prescription
    Then the system should process and confirm the prescription
    Examples:
      | medicine details                                   | prescription confirmed successfully             |
      | Incorrect medicine details                       | Error message for invalid medicine details     |

  #8 Doctor shall be able to prescribe lab tests
    Scenario: Doctor prescribes lab tests successfully
    Given the doctor has prescribed lab tests
    When the doctor submits the test details
    Then the system should process and confirm the lab tests
    Examples:
      | lab test details                                   | lab tests confirmed successfully             |
      | Incorrect lab test details                       | Error message for invalid test details       |

  #9 Admin shall handle appointment cancellations and rescheduling
    Scenario: Admin cancels and reschedules appointments
    Given the admin is logged in and an appointment is scheduled
    When the admin cancels the appointment
    And the admin reschedules it for a new date and time
    Then the system should cancel and reschedule the appointment
    Examples:
      | original appointment date and time | new appointment date and time | expected outcome                                  |
      | 2023-04-01 10:00 AM | 2023-04-03 03:00 PM | Appointment cancelled and rescheduled successfully |

```
